narrative:
Capex is GBP 64.2M in the FY2026 budget against GBP 57.5M of D&A — a reinvestment ratio of about 1.1×. AI and automation platforms for the AI Catalyst Stack are the largest programme at GBP 22M, followed by contract mobilisation and transition at GBP 18M.

End-user devices and network are GBP 10M, Amazon Connect telephony and workforce tools GBP 8M, and delivery site consolidation GBP 6M.

Right-of-use delivery sites depreciate over the lease term; software and mobilisation assets amortise over 5–7 years.

signals.title: £24.4bn pipeline, £998m H1 TCV
signals.excerpt: Book-to-bill 1.1x; Synergy Business Process Services from summer 2027 and a £425m TfL renewal signed in July.

signals.title: Snowflake chosen as the data layer of the AI Catalyst Stack
signals.excerpt: Multi-year agreement with Snowflake for data management and intelligence; Snowflake Select Partner status.
